name: descript
description: Import media, edit with Underlord, publish share links, and export transcripts or Premiere/Resolve timelines — from your agent.

interface.longDescription: Descript lets you edit video and audio by editing text. Import media from URLs or file uploads, create projects, and use Underlord — Descript's AI co-editor — to trim, rearrange, remove filler words, add captions, and more. Publish a shareable link, or export a transcript or a Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve timeline, all from your assistant.
defaultPrompt: Create a video project from these clips and remove the filler words
Publish my project as a shareable video link
Export my project's transcript as an SRT file
